gates.name: machine_truth
gates.pass_condition: fresh ObservedState exists and is explicitly distinct from declared/historical host data

gates.name: local_only
gates.pass_condition: confidential/restricted mission completes with evidence of zero remote provider use

gates.name: durable_human_gate
gates.pass_condition: mission state survives process restart while waiting for approval

gates.name: side_effects
gates.pass_condition: irreversible effects require HumanGate and compensable effects require idempotency plus compensation

gates.name: memory_poisoning
gates.pass_condition: unproven or contradictory knowledge is quarantined and cannot self-promote

gates.name: false_consensus
gates.pass_condition: agreement without evidence is insufficient and disagreement is preserved

gates.name: simulator_fidelity
gates.pass_condition: simulation cannot be routed without explicit fidelity evidence

gates.name: provider_swap
gates.pass_condition: provider substitution leaves canonical contracts unchanged

gates.name: projection_failure
gates.pass_condition: loss of Hall/UI projection does not delete canonical state

gates.name: outcome_eval
gates.pass_condition: success is assessed from observed result and evidence rather than agent narration

gates.name: retex_immunity
gates.pass_condition: a known failure can produce a test or guard that blocks recurrence
